baseline_models.focus_anchor: The mirrored clauses 'Allah, He is al-haqq' and 'what they call besides Him, it is al-batil.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated exclusive pronoun sorts objects of worship by ontological stability: one is fixed reality, while the rival class has no enduring ground.

activation_trace.role: The worship and worshipped image makes the mirrored predicates a classification of devotional objects.
Fixed correspondence with reality supplies the stable pole of the contrast.
Departure from truth and stability supplies the rival pole's lack of durable reality.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely says that God is true and other invocations are false.
changed_reading.after: The ayah classifies devotion by what can actually remain: God is the reality that holds, while every called-beside object lacks enduring ground.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence yad'una, al-haqq, and al-batil.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling can carry an assertion of right or affiliation, so the opposition also stages a dispute between a rightful claim and an invented claimant.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right or affiliation turns invocation into an asserted bond and entitlement.
A specific right possessed by its owner supplies the criterion of legitimate claim.
The image of alleging what has no reality marks the rival object as a claimant without title.

changed_reading.before: Calling is treated only as prayer directed to the wrong addressee.
changed_reading.after: The call also performs a claim of allegiance and authority; al-batil is the claimant that cannot establish title, while al-haqq is rightfully due.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Min dunihi is answered by al-'Ali and al-Kabir.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse builds a vertical axis from what remains below and short of the goal to the one whose elevation is mastery and whose is the principal affair.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that remains below or short of the endpoint places rival objects beneath the final goal.
Overcoming and mastery make divine height operative sovereignty rather than bare altitude.
The principal weight of an affair makes greatness the capacity to encompass and govern the whole matter.

changed_reading.before: Besides Him means only other than Him, and the closing names are honorifics.
changed_reading.after: The alternatives stop below the goal; al-'Ali al-Kabir names the sovereign who overtops and bears the entire order they cannot reach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verbal act yad'una is enclosed by al-batil, al-'Ali, and al-Kabir.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse contrasts speech that tries to incline a hearer toward an object with the actual ability to govern; the rival endpoint attracts address but is idle and nonbeneficial.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech supplies the human attempt to direct relation and expectation.
Idleness and loss of useful work make falsehood a nonperforming endpoint rather than only a wrong statement.
Mastery and overcoming supply the effective agency absent from the invoked rivals.

changed_reading.after: False also means causally idle: the call may pull attention, but its object cannot do the work expected of it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier identical formula is reached through inert earth becoming mobile, swelling, growing, and then through the claim that God gives life to the dead. Al-haqq therefore reads as generative reality demonstrated by transformation.

activation_trace.role: Fixed reality is the focus predicate whose mode of stability is revised from static to life-producing.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies the first visible transition out of inertness.
Feeding and growth turn the earth's swelling into a sustained developmental process.
Plant emergence from earth supplies the observable product of the transformation.
Life of earth through rain and growth carries the material sequence into the stated revival of the dead.

structural_cues: 22:5 moves from dormant earth through water, motion, swelling, and growth; 22:6 then repeats 'that is because Allah is al-haqq' before naming revival of the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transformation, growth, revival, and the repeated causal formula; I infer that generative efficacy is evidence for al-haqq. A live alternative is that the sequence only proves resurrection without defining the predicate's texture.

changed_reading.before: Al-haqq is a static metaphysical classification.
changed_reading.after: Al-haqq is the stable source whose reality shows itself by making dead-seeming matter cross into life and by promising that this transition is repeatable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of an alien casting, its removal, and the firming of the signs culminates in recognition that the message is al-haqq. Truth is not only untouched purity; it is also what divine correction restores and secures after intrusion.

activation_trace.role: Tightly woven speech supplies a textual-material image for the focus predicate.
Removal and invalidation supply the counter-operation applied to an intrusive element.
Casting something down supplies the intrusive placement that initiates the repair sequence.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the corrective transition rather than mere deletion.
Perfection, firmness, and reliability supply the secured state of the signs after correction.
Disclosure to the knower supplies recognition of the repaired message as al-haqq.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders casting, removal, and firming; 22:54 explicitly says that those given knowledge recognize the result as al-haqq from their Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repair sequence and its later naming as al-haqq; I infer that restorative governance belongs to the changed reading. The alternative is that these are separate claims about revelation and God rather than a gloss on al-haqq in 22:62.

changed_reading.before: Truth is imagined as whatever never encounters contamination.
changed_reading.after: Truth can pass through exposure, excision, and re-securing; al-Haqq names the agency that prevents intrusion from becoming the final textual state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated calling-besides is tested by a causal ladder: the objects do not control harm or benefit, cannot create a fly even by pooling strength, and cannot recover what the fly removes. Both requester and requested remain dependent.

activation_trace.role: Idleness and suspension from benefit provide the focus model that the context makes concrete.
Harm and deficiency as the opposite of benefit supply one side of the failed agency test.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the other side, both denied to the invoked object.
Calling and verbal inclination repeat the focus act at the start of the decisive capability test.
Origination and bringing creation into existence set the capability threshold the rivals cannot meet.
Gathering strength until its parts cohere shows that aggregation still cannot repair the deficit.
Extracting something from another's grip supplies the failed recovery operation.
The contrary of strength diagnoses both sides of the devotional exchange as weak.
Being made needy enough to seek exposes the dependence shared by seeker and sought.

structural_cues: 22:12 and 22:73 repeat the focus construction of calling besides Allah; the branchless theft in 22:73 turns inability into a miniature causal experiment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied harm and benefit, failed creation, pooled effort, theft, failed recovery, and weakness; I infer that these operations explain al-batil as causal nullity. The alternative is that the fly parable is only ridicule and not a general test of falsehood.

changed_reading.before: Al-batil is an incorrect object of belief.
changed_reading.after: Al-batil is a broken economy of agency: attention and requests flow toward it, but creation, protection, recovery, and even self-sufficiency do not flow back.

context_deltas.mechanism: Invocation establishes a claimed patronage bond. The bad patron cannot vindicate, whereas God supports the wronged and is the one to whom people hold fast; haqq and batil therefore distinguish rightful from fraudulent protection.

activation_trace.role: Claimed affiliation makes the focus call an attempted patronage bond.
A right held by its proper owner supplies legitimacy for the protective bond.
Love, support, and alliance supply the social role that the condemned patron fails to perform.
Transgressing the limit by aggression identifies the wrong against which protection is required.
Vindication of the wronged supplies the concrete act of true patronage.
A grasp that prevents and preserves supplies the reciprocal act of holding fast to the true protector.
Taking charge of an affair identifies God as the patron who can actually administer the bond.

structural_cues: The bad patron and associate of 22:13 is answered by God's promised vindication in 22:60 and the closing 'He is your patron, excellent patron and helper' in 22:78.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed patronage, aggression, vindication, holding fast, and the final patron formula; I infer that the focus call creates a rival protective claim. The alternative is that patronage is a neighboring consequence rather than part of the haqq-batil opposition itself.

changed_reading.before: The contrast concerns abstract truth and error between isolated individuals and objects.
changed_reading.after: The contrast also audits social allegiance: the false patron receives attachment without providing protection, while the true patron possesses the right and power to vindicate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Haqq becomes a norm of proportion and due response: retaliation is bounded by likeness, aggression crosses that bound, God must be appraised by the measure due Him, and striving is named by its due measure.

activation_trace.role: Binding obligation and fixed desert supply the focus predicate's normative dimension.
A false allegation supplies the contrary condition of claiming beyond one's due.
Punishment following an offense supplies the responsive legal sequence.
Equivalence and likeness impose proportionality on the response.
Aggression as crossing a limit marks the point where due proportion is violated.
Matching a thing to its measure supplies the explicit audit of whether God is appraised fittingly.
The due and binding image makes the stated measure one owed to God, not an optional estimate.
Exerting capacity under hardship supplies a second domain in which a due measure is demanded.

structural_cues: The focus predicate reappears inside 'the true measure of His measure' in 22:74 and 'the true measure of striving' in 22:78, after bounded retaliation in 22:60.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equivalence, limit-crossing, measure, repeated haqq, and exertion; I infer a shared proportional standard whose source is God. The alternative is that the repeated haqq constructions are independent intensifiers rather than one legal-measural mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Al-haqq identifies what exists or what is factually correct.
changed_reading.after: Al-haqq also identifies the due measure that keeps response, appraisal, and effort from falling into excess, deficiency, or unauthorized claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah turns vertical rank into a mechanics of support. Association produces a fall from the sky; raised construction can become an empty collapse; God holds the sky from falling. Divine height is thus the power that maintains levels, while rival elevation cannot support itself.

activation_trace.role: Being below and short of the goal supplies the lower position whose support is in question.
Mastery and overcoming make elevation the capacity to govern the vertical relation.
Noisy, disordered falling supplies the initial loss of support after association.
Descent into an abyss extends the fall into an uncontrolled trajectory.
Collapse and demolition show that visible construction does not guarantee stable elevation.
Raised and reinforced building supplies the monumental height that still fails.
Holding and restraining supplies the sustaining action that prevents cosmic collapse.
Falling and coming to rest supplies the event withheld from the sky.

structural_cues: 22:31 moves from sky to snatching and a remote abyss; 22:45 juxtaposes collapsed habitation and a raised palace; 22:65 says the sky is held from falling onto earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fall, abyss, collapsed and raised structures, holding, and prevented falling; I infer that the focus's lower/high axis encodes dependency and support. The live alternative is that al-'Ali denotes rank alone and these spatial scenes are only demonstrations of power.

changed_reading.before: Al-'Ali al-Kabir marks a static location or maximum scale above lesser beings.
changed_reading.after: Divine height is nondependent support: God maintains the layered order, while whatever is raised without that support can hollow, collapse, or be swept downward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same surah institutes rites for different communities and positively commands calling toward the Lord. The focus cannot condemn calling or ritual form as such; min dunihi and the rival object's claimed status are the decisive fault.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech identify the act whose moral value the context differentiates by direction.
Otherness and substitution identify the rival placement, rather than invocation itself, as the focus problem.
Worship and approach to God supply a valid ritual act assigned across communities.
Divine oneness without partner supplies the invariant orientation beneath varied rites.
Continuance on a way supplies the plurality of practiced communal paths without making plurality itself false.
The commanded call toward the Lord proves that the focus verb can carry a true orientation.
Gentle direction toward the path and truth supplies the positive trajectory of that call.

structural_cues: 22:34 combines a rite for every community with one deity; 22:67 again grants each community a rite and then commands 'call to your Lord.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies legitimate ritual plurality, divine oneness, and a commanded use of the focus verb; I infer that object and direction, not the bare act of calling, determine batil. The alternative is that the command uses a distinct rhetorical sense too remote to revise the focus use.

changed_reading.before: The verse appears to mark invocation and ritual plurality themselves as false.
changed_reading.after: Calling remains a valid directional act and rites may vary; batil begins when a call installs something as a substitute beside the one God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dispute is deferred to judgment, exhaustive knowledge, and a written record; the rival worship of 22:71 lacks both disclosed authority and knowledge. The emphatic haqq-batil pair reads as an evidentiary verdict on competing claims.

activation_trace.role: Establishing and manifesting truth supplies the focus verdict's evidentiary force.
A claim with no reality supplies the rival case that fails the audit.
Twisted dispute supplies the contested field in which rival claims circulate.
Judgment between people supplies the adjudicative act that resolves the dispute.
Each party taking a different path supplies the divergence submitted for judgment.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the comprehensive epistemic ground of the verdict.
A written fixing that entails judgment or decree supplies the durable record.
Compelling proof supplies the warrant explicitly absent from rival worship.

structural_cues: 22:68-71 moves from dispute to God's judgment, knowledge, and record, then denies rival worship both revealed authority and knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contest, adjudication, comprehensive knowledge, a record, and absent warrant; I infer that 22:62 voices the resulting verdict rather than an unsupported slogan. The alternative is that the judgment sequence concerns only future settlement, not the semantics of haqq now.

changed_reading.before: The verse asserts a binary and expects assent by repetition.
changed_reading.after: The verse sounds like a reasoned verdict: one claim is grounded in knowledge, record, and compelling warrant, while the rival claim has no admissible authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sacrificial matter does not reach God, while people magnify Him in response to guidance; nearby, God is self-sufficient. Al-Kabir therefore does not name a magnitude enlarged by offerings or praise, but greatness that precedes and enables their response.

activation_trace.role: Majesty and greatness properly belonging to God supply the focus name whose economy is clarified.
Reaching and attaining distinguish material that does not arrive from piety that does.
Regarding something as great locates magnification in the worshippers' recognition, not an increase in God.
Self-sufficiency supplies the reason divine greatness cannot depend on incoming ritual substance.

structural_cues: 22:37 denies that flesh and blood reach God but says piety does and commands magnification; 22:64 places divine ownership beside self-sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonarrival of sacrificial matter, responsive magnification, and self-sufficiency; I infer that al-Kabir is nonaugmentable greatness. The alternative is that the passage distinguishes sincerity from matter without addressing the ontology of greatness.

changed_reading.before: Al-Kabir suggests the largest being, made more prominent by accumulated offerings and praise.
changed_reading.after: Al-Kabir names greatness that receives no material increment; ritual recognition changes and orients the worshipper, not God's magnitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, night and day enter one another in a mirrored process under divine hearing and sight. Al-Haqq can therefore name the governor of permeable, changing boundaries, not one material pole trapped inside a static dualism.

activation_trace.role: Stable correspondence with reality supplies the invariant maintained through temporal change.
Mastery supplies governance over the crossing boundary rather than detachment from it.
One thing entering the interior of another supplies the reciprocal boundary-crossing mechanism.
Night as the contrary of day supplies one changing temporal state.
Day opening through light supplies the reciprocal state that enters and is entered.
Perception of sound supplies continuous awareness across the temporal transition.
Insight of the heart supplies awareness of the transition's inner order, not only its visible surface.

structural_cues: 22:61 and 22:62 share the deictic-causal opening 'that is because,' and both use mirrored clauses around repeated divine naming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal entry, temporal contraries, awareness, and immediate syntactic parallel; I infer that stable truth can govern transitions without being reducible to one temporal side. The alternative is that night-day alternation is only evidence of power and should not qualify the haqq-batil binary.

changed_reading.before: Truth and falsehood appear to imply that all reality is organized as two sealed, motionless blocks.
changed_reading.after: The ontological verdict remains binary, but al-Haqq is the transcendent governor of a world whose created boundaries can interpenetrate and change without escaping divine awareness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because batala and 'atala are distinct roots, so their consonantal and semantic resonance is not an etymology. It remains anchored in al-batil's packet branch of idleness and the actual disabled well within a collapsed settlement; downstream prose should present it only as a cross-root activation or image, never as a lexical derivation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-batil as loss of useful work or benefit.

activation_trace.role: Idleness and suspension from benefit supply the focus image of nonfunction.
Emptiness and disabling supply the image of a well whose form remains while its social function has ceased.
Vacancy and emptiness extend nonfunction from the well to the surrounding settlement.

changed_reading.before: Falsehood is an active rival doctrine.
changed_reading.after: Falsehood may also be imaged as abandoned infrastructure: an apparent capacity left empty, disconnected, and unable to deliver its promised benefit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The sequential-falling branch of da'a is form-distant from ordinary invocation, which makes this a latent image rather than a translation. It remains anchored in yad'una and is independently activated by the surah's fall and prevented-fall sequence; downstream prose should mark the cascade as exploratory and retain ordinary calling as the primary sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yad'una beside the lower/high axis of min dunihi and al-'Ali.

activation_trace.role: Parts falling one after another supply a latent cascade inside the focus root inventory.
Disordered falling from the sky gives the latent cascade a visible contextual scene.
Holding and restraining supply the divine counterforce that interrupts a cascade.
Falling and settling name the cosmic event that is actively withheld.

changed_reading.before: Calling besides God is a discrete verbal mistake.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, rival invocation initiates a dependency cascade: unsupported attachments pass failure downward, whereas divine holding prevents the whole order from falling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The joint-and-container branch of haqq is materially distant from the divine predicate, so it should not replace the stable-reality reading. It remains anchored in al-haqq and gains a coherent spatial mechanism from entry, holding, and fitting measure; downstream prose should render it as an analogy of exact fit, not a literal definition of God.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-haqq between min dunihi and al-'Ali al-Kabir.

activation_trace.role: A right piece fitting its joint or container supplies the material image of exact relational fit.
One state entering another supplies moving parts that must remain coherently related.
Holding and restraint supply the force that keeps fitted levels from separating.
A thing matching its measure supplies the criterion for proper fit rather than arbitrary contact.

changed_reading.before: Truth is only correspondence between a statement and a fact.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, al-Haqq is the exact fit that lets changing parts, levels, and measures remain one coherent order instead of dislocating.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's non-dominant mapped da'' root and is therefore deliberately form-distant. It remains anchored in the focus occurrence and is triggered by 22:72's near-action branch immediately followed by a branchless verb of assault; downstream prose must label it a split-root latent resonance, not translate yad'una as violent pushing or invent a branch for the assault verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yad'una as resolved by the packet to both da'a and the non-dominant da'' inventory.

activation_trace.role: A severe shove or rebuff supplies the split-root image of coercive pressure latent beside ordinary calling.
Asserting what has no reality supplies the false claim that coercion tries to sustain.
Nearness to performing an act supplies the threshold immediately before the uncited assault in the verse.

changed_reading.before: False invocation remains private speech directed outward.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory split-root level, an unsupported claim may convert verbal calling into pressure against the signs and those who recite them.

strongest_changes: Al-haqq shifted from a static label to generative and restorative agency: it revives inert matter and secures revelation after intrusion.
Al-batil became a failed causal and patronage economy whose objects receive calls but cannot benefit, create, recover, protect, or vindicate.
The contrast acquired a normative and evidentiary dimension through due measure, bounded response, judgment, knowledge, record, and warrant.
The act of calling was separated from its object: calling toward the Lord is commanded and ritual forms may vary, while substitution beside God is the fault.
Al-'Ali al-Kabir shifted from sheer altitude or size toward sustaining sovereignty and greatness that cannot be materially augmented.
summary.what_was_special: The same causal formula at 22:6 and the immediate mirrored formula at 22:61 activated life, repair, boundary, support, legal, social, and ritual readings without forcing them into one interpretation. The packet's split mapping for da'a also preserved a coercive outlier, while the disabled well activated a carefully contained cross-root image of batil as abandoned function.
remaining_uncertainties: The joint, cascade, coercive, and disabled-infrastructure readings are branch-valid but materially or form-distant and should remain qualified activations.
The context may demonstrate consequences of divine truth rather than define the predicates al-haqq, al-'Ali, and al-Kabir themselves.
Night-day interpenetration may revise a static reading of the binary, or it may serve only as adjacent evidence of divine power.
The legal uses of haqq may form one proportional mechanism, or may remain separate idioms of due appraisal and due exertion.
